purpose: Potion-only motion preview; not connected to the live crafting renderer.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated cauldron sprite for a polished fantasy RPG crafting animation, viewed at 192x192 pixels. Make ONE sturdy dark cast-iron cauldron, broad rounded belly, small brass side handles, three short feet, filled with a smooth still deep ruby-red potion. The open top is a clean symmetrical horizontal ellipse, viewed slightly from above so the full liquid surface is visible, with a clear thick dark iron front lip and rim. Large simple readable shapes, refined hand-painted game item art with crisp dark silhouette and restrained warm metallic highlights. Cauldron centered, full object including feet visible, three-quarter elevation but perfectly symmetrical straight-on orientation; pot occupies about 75 percent of square image width. Empty transparent space above the pot for a spoon and steam to be animated later. The liquid surface is FLAT, STILL and SIMPLE, with no bubbles, no swirling patterns, no reflection objects, no steam. No spoon, no tools, no fire, no wood, no floor, no scenery, no shadow outside the object, no border, no writing, no watermark. Genuinely transparent background.
motion: Two healing herbs and one bitterroot fall in staggered arcs, sink below the liquid, and create droplets and expanding ripples. Each contact blooms with a local potion glow and twenty-one large zigzagging magical sparks in amber gold, amethyst violet, and icy blue. Independently seeded angular paths, uneven segment speeds, staggered lifetimes, and trails that follow the actual bends replace the radial arcs. Colored halos and prominent four-point glints remain. The spoon then eases into two continuous orbits at the previously approved peak speed, before lifting at completion. Fixed cauldron, waterline occlusion, phase-coupled liquid highlights, and deterministic bubbles. Total crafting duration is 5.8 seconds.
fireMotion: Painted flame emission: staggered tongues emerge from five anchored sources, grow, rise, curl, taper and extinguish over independent lifetimes. Each ingredient contact drives an eased 1.09-second flare: individual tongues grow taller and slightly fuller, then return to their normal size. Clean stationary hearth with no baked flames; no image displacement. The foreground wood occludes the flame roots. Seamless 6.5-second loop including the finish hold.
smokeMotion: Broad painted plumes expand and rise above the potion, with denser smoke drifting behind the hearth. Each ingredient releases an additional billow. Steam is layered behind the spoon and falling ingredients so the brewing action stays readable. Independent overlapping lifetimes and a seamless 6.5-second loop keep the smoke moving through the finish hold.
